sourceReview.reason: Full-text Coinfomania and TokenPost reports dated 2026-11-14 describe MSFT, SONY, TTWO and AMD access on 1inch/Base, but both appear to derive from the same 1inch social announcement. The 1inch primary blog dated 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-23 already documents Coinbase tokenized equities and 1inch routing on Base, including Microsoft. No independently verified new launch date, issuer details or three distinct new facts establish a fresh event. Retry no sooner than six hours after reviewedAt; require a dated primary release or two genuinely independent full-text reports.
